import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the aesthetics for the plot
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', 
                           size='weight_grams', sizes=(20, 200), alpha=0.7)

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Camera Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
